notes: Single run, no prior attempts. Translated the Table 2 and Table 3 regressions of Code/analysis.do: loaded Data/Clean Data/choice_experiments.dta, dropped non-professional (study!=1) participants with missing alphavaluefinal, restricted to Highx10==0 & Highx100==0, and ran OLS (lm) with HC3 robust SEs (sandwich::vcovHC) on the authors' covariates2 list. Table 2 col 2 restricts to professionals==0; col 3 drops professionals implicitly via missing stdalpha (as in Stata). Table 3 cols 1/2 split on getyourchoice==1/0; col 3 pools and adds notgetyourchoice and its interactions. Collinear terms (professionalsfree, professionalscloudresearch in AMT-only samples) are dropped as in Stata. Run done in a scratch directory and copied into the output directory. The run took about 1.4 s and did not hang. I did not compare results with the claims through check_attempt or change the script afterwards.
